title: Cambridge IELTS 19 Academic Speaking Test 2 (Online Test)

parts.title: Part 1 — Introduction and interview
parts.instructions: The examiner will ask general questions about yourself and a few familiar topics. Answer naturally and try to extend each answer with a reason or example. This part lasts 4–5 minutes.

questions.question: Have you travelled a lot by plane? [To where?/Why not?]
Why do you think some people enjoy travelling by plane?
Would you like to live near an airport? [Why/Why not?]
In the future, do you think that you will travel by plane more often? [Why/Why not?]

parts.title: Part 2 — Individual long turn
parts.instructions: You will be given a topic card. You have one minute to prepare and may make notes. Then speak for one to two minutes. Try to keep talking until the examiner stops you.
parts.cue_card_topic: Describe a person from your country who has won a prize, award or medal.
cue_card_bullets: which prize, award or medal they received
what they did to win this
and explain whether you think it was right that this person received this prize, award or medal

parts.title: Part 3 — Two-way discussion
parts.instructions: The examiner will ask further questions connected to the Part 2 topic. These are more abstract and require you to explain, compare, and speculate. Try to give extended, well-reasoned answers. This part lasts 4–5 minutes.

questions.question: What types of school prizes do children in your country receive?
What do you think are the advantages of rewarding schoolchildren for good work?
Do you agree that it's more important for children to receive rewards from their parents than from teachers?
Do you think that some sportspeople (e.g., top footballers) are paid too much money?
Should everyone on a team get the same prize money when they win?
Do you agree with the view that, in sport, taking part is more important than winning?
